editor.title: CV scoring rubric
editor.hint: Candidate CVs are scored strictly against these criteria: AI gives each criterion 0–100 with quotes from the CV, and the final score is the weighted average. Without a rubric no CV can be scored.
editor.aiNeedsContent: Enter the position and a description or candidate requirements before asking AI.
editor.replaceConfirm: Replace the current criteria with the new ones?
editor.noTemplates: No templates yet — HR Admins add them on the Playbook screen.
editor.name: Criterion name
editor.guidePlaceholder: What does a strong candidate show in the CV?
editor.levelsHint: Describe each score band concretely (years, technologies, measurable results) so AI scores consistently.

levelPlaceholder.excellent: e.g. 4+ years shipping real products, technical leadership
levelPlaceholder.good: e.g. 2–4 years in the same domain
levelPlaceholder.fair: e.g. Under 2 years or an adjacent domain

problems.badWeight: Each weight must be greater than 0.
problems.missingGuide: Each criterion needs a scoring guide or at least one score band.
problems.tooManyChecks: At most 8 checklist items per criterion.

editor.empty: No criteria yet. Use "AI suggest", pick a company template, import Excel or add them manually.
editor.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

checks.title: Checklist ({{count}})
checks.hint: The AI only answers yes/no per item with a quote; the score inside the band = band floor + share of items met × band width.
checks.emptyHint: No checklist yet — the AI will estimate where the score sits inside the band. Add 3–5 signals verifiable from a CV so two CVs in the same band are ranked correctly.
checks.readOnlyTitle: Checklist (decides the score inside the band):

panel.title: CV scoring rubric
panel.missing: This job has no rubric — it cannot be submitted or published, and incoming applications are waiting to be scored.
panel.pending: {{count}} applications waiting to be scored with this rubric
panel.rescoreWarning: Saving a new rubric re-scores {{count}} applications of this job. Previous scores are kept as history.
panel.saved: Saved. Applications are being re-scored with the new rubric.
panel.readOnlyHint: The job's primary Hiring Manager manages this rubric.

status.retryingSoon: Retries on the next scoring sweep

breakdown.title: CV score and how it was calculated
breakdown.subtitle: Scored against the rubric the Hiring Manager set for this job
breakdown.noEvidence: The CV has no evidence for this criterion.
breakdown.excludedHint: AI could not score these criteria, so they are excluded from both numerator and denominator — they do not count as 0.
breakdown.oldRubric: This score was calculated with a previous rubric version.

state.rescoring: The Hiring Manager just updated the rubric — this application is being re-scored. Below is the score under the previous rubric.
state.queued: AI is scoring this CV against the job's rubric. The result will appear automatically.
state.pending_rubric: This job has no CV scoring rubric yet, so the application has not been scored. The Hiring Manager needs to add one on the job screen.
state.invalid_cv: AI determined the uploaded file is not a CV.
state.no_cv: This application has no CV file to score.
state.scoring_failed: The CV could not be scored: {{reason}}.

breakdown.retryAt: It will be retried automatically at {{time}} — no action needed.
breakdown.retrySoon: It will be retried on the next scoring sweep — no action needed.
breakdown.previousScoreShown: Below is the score under the previous rubric.

failureReason.ai_unavailable: the AI service is failing or overloaded
failureReason.cv_unreadable: the CV file could not be read
failureReason.no_criterion_scored: the AI did not score any criterion of the rubric

checks.unsupported: Marked as met by the AI without a supporting quote — not counted.
checks.unanswered: Not answered by the AI — left out of the denominator.

position.title: Score inside the band
position.ai: {{band}} band ({{min}}–{{max}}) · this criterion has no checklist, so the AI estimated the position inside the band.
position.aiNoBand: Score estimated by the AI (scored before checklists existed).

jobChip.missing: No CV scoring rubric — cannot be submitted yet

requestMissing: This request has no CV scoring rubric (created before rubrics became mandatory) — the Hiring Manager must edit the request to add one before it can be approved.

createJob.title: CV scoring rubric
createJob.fromRequest: Set by the Hiring Manager on the request — the job will score CVs with it. The HM can edit it on the job screen.
createJob.missing: This request has no rubric. You can still create the job, but the Hiring Manager must add a rubric on the job screen before you submit it.

interviewEditor.hint: The AI scores the candidate's answers against exactly these criteria: 0–100 per criterion, then a weighted average compared with the job's pass mark. Without criteria the interview produces no report.
interviewEditor.guidePlaceholder: What does a strong answer show?
interviewEditor.levelsHint: Describe answers in each score band (correct fundamentals, real examples, trade-offs…) so the AI scores consistently.

levelPlaceholder.excellent: E.g. Explains the fundamentals correctly, covers trade-offs and edge cases
levelPlaceholder.good: E.g. Gets the main points right with an example, but not in depth
levelPlaceholder.fair: E.g. Partly right, some concepts confused
levelPlaceholder.poor: E.g. Wrong or unable to answer

interviewEditor.noTemplates: No templates yet — an HR Admin adds interview rubric templates on the Playbook page.
interviewEditor.empty: No criteria yet. Use "AI suggest", pick a company template, import Excel or add them by hand.
interviewEditor.aiNeedsContent: The job needs a title and a description before the AI can suggest criteria.

interviewPanel.title: Interview scoring criteria
interviewPanel.jobLevelTitle: Shared set · applies to every interview round
interviewPanel.roundEditHint: This set applies to this round only. Removing it makes the round use the job's shared set again.
interviewPanel.missing: Round {{rounds}} has no scoring criteria — its interviews will not get a report, and the job cannot be published.
interviewPanel.waiting: {{count}} finished interview(s) are waiting for scoring criteria. Once you save the criteria the reports are generated automatically.
interviewPanel.empty: No criteria yet. The job's primary Hiring Manager sets the interview scoring criteria before publishing.
interviewPanel.savedWithWaiting: Saved. The waiting interviews have been queued for scoring — their reports appear automatically when done.
interviewPanel.roundRemoved: Own set removed — this round now uses the job's shared set.
